title: Slow, but gets the job done
text:
Slow, but gets the job done. We got an electric can opener because of a dominant hand injury, so this was really helpful to allow me to keep cooking. And while it was very helpful not to have to open cans on my own, it’s not exactly the fastest can opener.
I normally have to push the button to run it at least twice. It makes about four rotations around the can before it actually opens it. I wish it was quicker. But since I can open cans on my own, this is definitely helpful and great for my kitchen.
